sn48.51:1.5: The five faculties are “qualities on the side of awakening” (bodhipakkhiyā dhammā) because they lead to awakening (SN 48.51:2.6). This term is used repeatedly in this Saṁyutta in this sense. Outside of this context, it is used occasionally in the general sense of meditative development, without further specification (AN 5.56:3.1). In three instances it is extended to “seven” such qualities (DN 27:30.5, Iti 82:3.1, Iti 97:4.2), which the commentary identifies with the seven sets of dhammas totaling 37 (rather than the seven awakening factors alone). We also find the synonymous phrase sambodhipakkhika at AN 9.1. At Thag 16.9:9.2 we find qualities that are “skillful, on the side of awakening” (kusalā bodhipakkhikā), cementing the connection with the expressions “on the side of the skillful” or “on the side of the unskillful” (SN 46.31:1.1, MN 117:36.1, AN 1.56:1.1). The qualities “on the side of awakening” oppose those “on the side of Māra” (Thag 4.4:1.2).
